evidence_rules: Direct application confirmations and interview correspondence outrank generic job alerts.
Job alerts that continued after the April 2026 RTEC start are background subscriptions, not evidence of a resumed active job search.
Historical self-descriptions are retained with dates and must not silently become current credentials.
No salary, contact details, exact addresses, institutional identifiers, or sensitive application-form data are retained.
